## Hacker Devil (Lislaroth) (CR 10)

**XP** 9,600  
LE Medium outsider (devil, evil, extraplanar, lawful)  
**Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., see in darkness; Perception +28  


**Defense**


**AC** 25, touch 24, flat-footed 11 (+1 Dex, +1 dodge, +13 natural)  
**hp** 195 (15d10+45)  
**Fort** +16; **Ref** +12; **Will** +17  
**DR** 5/good; **Immunities** fire, poison; **Resistances** acid 10, cold 10; **SR** 21  
**Weaknesses** technomagical susceptibility  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., fly 60 ft. (perfect)  
**Melee** claw +16 (2d8+1 slashing)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 10th, concentration +15)  


1/day—summon (level 4, 2 imps 60%)  

5/day—lightning bolt (DC 18)  

At will—invisibility (self only), major image (DC 18)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 13, **Dex** 13, **Con** 17, **Int** 26, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 20  
**Base Atk** +15; **CMB** +16; **CMD** 27  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Bluff +28, Diplomacy +28, Intimidate +28, Knowledge (engineering) +31, Knowledge (planes) +31, Knowledge (religion) +31, Perception +28, Sense Motive +25, Stealth +24  
**Languages** Celestial, Draconic, Infernal; telepathy 100 ft.
